name: witchs_cauldron_sacrifices_a_creature_its_controller_does_not_own
notes: Cause D of KNOWLEDGE/2026-11-17/212 (a cost read ownership where the rules say control), set up directly with the runner's controlled_by: seat 1 owns the Ogre and seat 0 controls it (the engine's own GAIN_CONTROL overlay). Witch's Cauldron: '{1}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature: You gain 1 life and draw a card.' A player sacrifices a permanent they control (CR 701.21a), so seat 0 may sacrifice the Ogre, its only creature: the Ogre goes to its OWNER's graveyard (CR 400.3), seat 0 gains 1 and draws 1. Before E2's fix (c3e3a28a) the cost found no creature seat 0 could sacrifice and the activation was refused; until 2026-11-17 a pack could reach a non-owner's control only by casting Traitorous Greed.
